Original fantasy RPG architectural texture atlas, using reference only for pixel-detail quality and coherent lighting. EXACT THREE COLUMNS x TWO ROWS of SIX distinct FRONT WALL ELEVATIONS. Every cell a full rectangle wall, straight-on orthographic NO perspective, 2 floors, door reaches bottom edge and occupies30% cell height, NO roof or sky, NO outdoor ground. Buildings distinct: top-left pale limestone apothecary with sage shutters/arched dark green door and herbs; top-middle cream plaster and dark oak half-timber inn with blue windows and copper door; top-right weathered gray stone guildhouse with tall arched indigo door and fine carved columns. Bottom-left cozy ivory-and-dark-timber cottage with teal door and small leaded windows; bottom-middle russet brick bakery with cream trim, warm oval windows and oak door; bottom-right pale gray civic library with dark blue double doors, restrained classical window arches. Ornamental stone, window frames, varied flower boxes and vines, natural weathering, shaded pixel clusters. Shared visual language but six genuinely different designs. NO painted sunbeams or cast ground shadows, mostly diffuse neutral daytime light, a little warm candle in windows. Make atlas edge-to-edge cells easy to slice, no labels/text, gutters or margin. Each cell equal exact size, three across two down. Aspect ratio approx3:2. Detailed 16-bit diorama textures.
